annotations.title: DCF + Owner Earnings + Damodaran intrinsic value

description: Per-method intrinsic value per share (DCF on free cash flow, owner earnings, Damodaran two-stage), their equal-weight blend, Monte Carlo bounds and the implied gap to the current price, and the lead value the DeepValues apps headline (`lead_method`, `lead_intrinsic_value`, `lead_upside_pct`, `values.lead_intrinsic_value_per_share`): Owner Earnings, or the DCF and then Damodaran when Owner Earnings has no positive value. The blend is checked against the price before it is served: if it fails a check (not positive, more than 20x the price, a price older than five days, no price, or `currency_consistent`: statements left in a currency other than the USD price), the valuation fields are null, `withheld` is true, `checks.failed` names the check and the call is not charged. A value under 0.05x the price is served with the flag `iv_far_below_price`. A value built from statements converted to USD carries `fx` (`from` the filer's currency, `to` USD, `rate`, `rate_date`, `rate_type`) on `values.intrinsic_value_per_share` and each method input; `currency_unverified` in `checks.flags` means the statement currency is not known for this ticker, so the check did not run. A method with no value is null in `methods`, never 0, and `methods_unavailable` says why (`code`, `family`: negative_cash_flow, financial_company, withheld or missing_inputs, and the pipeline's `reason`). For a one-call answer with holders and a verdict, use /brief/{ticker}. (GET https://app.deepvalues.ai/api/v1/intrinsic-value/{ticker}, e.g. https://app.deepvalues.ai/api/v1/intrinsic-value/AAPL — 0.02 credits per call; works with no credentials up to 5 call(s)/day per address) Missing data? Call `request_data`.

ticker.description: The real ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL; share classes as BRK.B or BRK-B. Substitute it into the path (/fundamentals/AAPL), never the literal {ticker}.
